blocks.text:
LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS
AS ON 2.2.1983

blocks.html:
1.Smt. Indira Gandhi-Prime Minister (All Ministries/Departments not specified below).
2.Shri Pranab Kumar Mukherjee-Minister of Finance.
3.Shri P.V. Narasimha Rao-Minister of External Affairs.
4.Shri P.C. Sethi-Minister of Home Affairs.
5.Shri Shiv Shankar-Minister of Energy.
6.Shri R. Venkataraman-Minister of Defence.
7.Shri A.B.A.Ghani KhanChaudhuri-Minister of Railways.
8.Shri S.B. Chavan-Minister of Planning.
9.Shri Jagannath Kaushal-Minister of Law,Justice andCompany Affairs.
10.Shri Veerendra Patil-Minister of Labour & Rehabilitation.
11.Shri K. Vijaya Bhaskara Reddy-Minister without portfolio (tempo-rarily holding charge of the M/oShipping and Transport).
12.Shri Vasant Sathe-Minister of Chemicals and Fertilizers.
13.Shri B. Shankaranand-Minister of Health & Family Welfare.
14.Shri A.P. Sharma-Minister of Communications.
15.Shri Bhishma Narain Singh-Minister of Civil Supplies & Supply.
16.Rao Birendra Singh-Minister of Agriculture.
17.Shri Buta Singh-Minister of Parliamentary Affairs,Sports and Works and Housing.
18.Shri Vishwanath Pratap Singh-Minister of Commerce.
19.Shri Narayan Datt Tiwari-Minister of Industry and Steeland Mines.
